card.name: End of INR and dosing words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a medical term just before a closing bracket or a following phrase, mostly the R in (INR) and the ing in 'dosing' after 'begin' or 'initiate'.

modes.label: INR abbreviation
modes.description: The letter R closing the abbreviation INR after 'international normalized ratio' in warfarin interaction notes.
modes.example: Monitor the International Normalized Ratio (IN<<R>>) when EVOTAZ is coadmin

modes.label: Dosing after begin
modes.description: The ending 'ing' of 'dosing' in instructions to begin or initiate treatment.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION • Begin varenicline tablets dos<<ing>> one week before the date set by the

modes.label: Corticosteroid word
modes.description: A middle piece inside the word corticosteroids.
modes.example: Taper patients slowly from systemic cortic<<oster>>oids if transferring to budesonide

card.writes: It slightly favors small linking words like 's, 'also', 'the' and an opening parenthesis after a completed term.
card.plain: It fires as a medical term like INR or dosing is finishing, right before the text moves on to a linking word or bracket.
